title: Runtime sync playbook + agenda (Lin scratchpad)
body:
Purpose: quick, repeatable weekly for the runtime/infra/console cross-functional squad. This is a personal scratchpad I use to run the meeting and capture follow-ups. Treat as lightweight — copy items into the team tracker after the sync.

Meeting length: 45 minutes (strict). Format: ritual + round-robin (90s each) + 15-minute deep dive/topic + 10-minute action review + parking lot.

Opening ritual (2 min)
- Quick welcome, attendance. Call out any folks joining late or hands-off for today.
- Highlight the main decision we want to make this week (see Deep Dive).

Round-robin status (90s per subteam: runtime infra / console / SRE / performance) (12–15 min)- For each speaker: 3 bullets max: (1) one headline, (2) current blocker, (3) ask or decision needed.
- Guideline: avoid long updates; use comments in doc or the #runtime-sync Slack thread for details.

Ops temperature & incidents (5 min)- Any P0/P1 from last 7 days? Short postmortem link if available.
- Current capacity crunches, hot shards, or region outages.

Deep dive / decision topic (15 min)- This week: "KV cache eviction behavior under mixed QPS". Goal: decide whether to ship the two safer knobs (evict-on-read threshold + max-prefix-size) as defaults for Dedicated customers or gate behind flag.
- Pre-reads: perf-run logs (linked), slides from Maya (GH PR above).
- Success criteria for decision: minimal regression (<3% latency tail) in staging + no memory blowouts on medium workloads.
- If we can't decide: action -> short A/B rollout plan with canary in us-west-2. Owner for rollout: Arjun.

Action review (10 min)- Live review of outstanding action items from last week. I read the list, call status, and mark owners to update tracker.

Parking lot & closing (1–2 min)- Capture items we deferred. Confirm next meeting's owner for facilitation.

My facilitator checklist (pre-meeting)
- Post agenda in #runtime-sync at least 24h prior.
- Ping owners for pre-reads (do at -36h).
- Create quick MTR snapshot (latency/cost) for the last 7 days and attach.

Prep notes (what I will say)
- "Folks — two asks: keep updates tight; add details to the doc or Slack thread. We're primarily here to unblock decisions and surface cross-team risks."
- Remind infra to report expected capacity drops when making infra changes (time window + affected model classes).

Open issues I want surfaced this week- Console: regression in model selection dropdown when route contains long names (ticket JIRA-4821). Need triage: UX or backend? Owner: Maya.
- Serving runtime: memory spike in q3 for v1.3.2 on p4d. Tentative root cause: faulty KV refill loop. Owner: Arjun.
- Dedicated: customer-reported 95th latencies in eu-west-1 during business hours. Add region-specific autoscale policy? Owner: Aisha.

Action items (captured live during sync) — example lines for copy into tracker
- [ ] Decide default kv-eviction knobs for Dedicated (decision or rollout plan). owner: Arjun; due: 2026-03-18; status: in_progress
- [ ] Triage model dropdown regression and assign PR. owner: Maya; due: 2026-03-16; status: open
- [ ] Collect postmortem notes for last week's cache incident and publish. owner: Lin Chen; due: 2026-03-12; status: done
- [ ] Draft canary rollout steps for evict-knobs (preflight checks + rollback plan). owner: Arjun; due: 2026-03-17; status: open
- [ ] Add eu-west-1 autoscale experiment to Dedicated runbook. owner: Aisha; due: 2026-03-20; status: open

Notes to self / loose thoughts (scratchpad)
- We should keep a template for quick A/B rollouts (metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99 tokens/sec, memory RSS, OOM counts, error-rate).
- Consider automating the "who to page" list if certain SLOs breach (small lambda to post to PagerDuty + Slack).
- Follow-up: ask Product about acceptable latency regressions when enabling new defaults for Dedicated customers.

Pre-reads / links I will paste in the thread
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789
- JIRA ticket: JIRA-4821
- Perf snapshot (internal): confluence:perf-snapshots/2026-03-08

After-meeting checklist (my personal follow-ups)
- Move action items into team tracker (I own the copy/paste this meeting).
- Ping Arjun for canary timeline and confirm rollout window.
- Remind Maya to create PR for the dropdown fix; offer console test harness env if needed.

Facilitation notes for next week (things to try)
- Start with the Ops temperature first if any active incidents exist — reduces context switching.
- Timebox the deep dive strictly: use a hard 15-min alarm and move unresolved discussion to a break-out.

Quick appendix: suggested phrasing for calling a decision- "Decision: enable knob X as default for Dedicated customers with fallback to old behavior via feature flag. Action: Arjun to schedule canary; if metrics deviate >3% on p95, rollback and revisit."

---
Metadata: kept minimal in Drive copy. After the meeting I'll transfer finalized items to the eng-serving-runtime tracker and mark this doc as archived copy for my notes.

End of scratchpad.
